item.title: Riley Strain Vanished After a Night Out. 2 Weeks Later, He Was Found Dead
item.description: In March 2024, 22-year-old Riley Strain disappeared after leaving a Nashville bar. His body was discovered in the Cumberland River, and an autopsy later ruled his death an accidental drowning involving alcohol intoxication

item.title: Kelly Cochran's Marriage Pact Led to Two Murders
item.description: Kelly Cochran and her husband Jason made a deadly pact involving infidelity. After Christopher Regan was murdered in Michigan in 2014, Kelly later killed Jason. She received life in prison plus an additional 65 years.
